The '''Tabal Comet''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cica]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entrus]]. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Kelthizar Nimm]], an agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], worked there as a [[dealer]] as part of his cover.
